topics.name: NVIDIA Global AI Expansion
topics.summary: NVIDIA announced DGX Cloud Lepton GPU marketplace connecting developers to neo clouds, partnership for Europe's largest AI campus in France, AI supercomputer in Taiwan with Foxconn and TSMC, and advanced talks to invest in PsiQuantum. Jensen Wong on a relentless global deal-making tour.

topics.name: Apple Intelligence Failures
topics.summary: Mark Gurman's Bloomberg deep dive detailed Apple's seven-year struggle under John Giannandrea to catch up in AI. iPhone 16 launched without promised AI features, Siri revamp indefinitely delayed, class action lawsuits filed; Apple's hardware culture clashes with inherently imperfect generative AI.

topics.name: US Middle East AI Deals
topics.summary: Trump administration signed AI acceleration partnerships with Saudi Arabia and UAE, requiring matching US data center investments, American company operation of GPUs, and rigorous security protocols. Framed as locking allies into American AI ecosystem and countering China's Belt-and-Road AI strategy.

topics.name: 23andMe Acquisition by Regeneron
topics.summary: Regeneron acquired 23andMe out of bankruptcy for $256M, pledging to maintain privacy policies. Concerns remain about genetic data under new ownership; Lemonade Health being wound down. Genetic data described by insiders as not particularly valuable in current form.

topics.name: Chinese Solar Inverter Security Threat
topics.summary: Reuters reported hidden cellular communication modules found inside Chinese-made solar inverters and batteries from companies like Huawei and Sungrow, enabling undocumented remote access to US electrical grid. Compared to Huawei telecom equipment backdoors discovered 2018-2020.

topics.name: Quantum Computing Investment Wave
topics.summary: NVIDIA in advanced talks to invest in PsiQuantum at ~$6B valuation; previously invested in Sandbox AQ. Jensen Wong shifted from calling quantum 20 years away in January to hosting Quantum Day at GTC in March. Rigetti up 700% in six months.

topics.name: AI Coding Market Evolution
topics.summary: Post-Windsurf acquisition by OpenAI and Codex launch, market segmenting into consumer (ChatGPT), prosumer (Codex), and professional IDE (Cursor, Windsurf) tiers. Revenue growth high but churn concerns exist; market may be past peak growth phase.

topics.name: Microsoft Layoffs and AI Automation
topics.summary: Microsoft laid off 6,000 employees (~3% of staff), with engineering hit hardest. A VP directed teams to use AI for 50% of code generation. Company dog-fooding AI tools while selling same automation to enterprise customers.

topics.name: US Fiscal Concerns and Moody's Downgrade
topics.summary: Moody's stripped the US of its last triple-A credit rating citing deficits and rising interest costs. House Budget Committee approved Trump's tax bill projected to add trillions to deficit. Stock market largely shrugged off the news while Bitcoin hit 105K.

topics.name: Xiaomi Chip Design and EV Expansion
topics.summary: Xiaomi plans $7B in chip design investment over a decade, launching a 3nm mobile chip this week and first electric SUV (YU7). Stock up 50%+ YTD; reclaimed number one spot in Chinese smartphone market.

topics.name: Startup Financing Framework - First 40 Months
topics.summary: Michael Dempsey outlined his thesis that founders should model milestones across first two funding rounds (~40 months) rather than sprint between raises, especially as VC has become momentum-driven and bars have risen significantly since 2021.

topics.name: Deep Tech and Autonomous Science Investing
topics.summary: Compound discussed investment thesis across bio, ML, robotics, crypto; skeptical of pure lab-workflow digitization startups but bullish on enabling structured experiments for eventual robotic scientists. Notes talent density as biggest crypto problem.

topics.name: American AI Domestic Action Plan
topics.summary: Sriram Krishnan previewed upcoming American AI Action Plan due in ~6 weeks covering domestic AI promotion (energy, open source, regulation) and protection of US AI secrets and supply chains from adversaries.

topics.name: Taiwan Nuclear Energy Decommission
topics.summary: Taiwan decommissioned its last nuclear reactor, becoming more energy import-dependent. Discussed in context of adversarial influence campaigns that pushed denuclearization in Germany and energy dependence on Russia.

topics.name: Private Company Research and Secondary Markets
topics.summary: Sacra discussed how secondary marketplaces need research content to engage buyers and sellers; LinkedIn accomplishment posts and FDIC filings are novel data sources; company covers ~300 high-growth private companies.
